newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rodamco in NLG 290 million Singapore investment.
newsitem.headline: Rodamco in NLG 290 million Singapore investment.

text.p: Dutch property investment company Rodamco said on Thursday it had taken a 30 percent interest in a building in the traditional commercial centre of Singapore for 290 million guilders.

Rodamco said it took the interest in a 16-storey office development in China Square, between Raffles Place and Shenton Way. The tower will contain around 31,000 square meteres of net leasable office space, the company said in a statement.
The development is scheduled for completion in December 1998.
The remaining 70 percent stake is held by SSL Properties Private Ltd, a unit of Keppel Land Ltd, which is the property arm of Singapore's Keppel Corporation conglomerate.
